from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im=np.array(Image.open('observations/obs_0099.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
# dark brown table: R>80,R<160, G,B lower
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
mask=(R>70)&(R<170)&(G>25)&(G<95)&(B<75)&(R-B>40)&(R-G>25)
ys,xs=np.nonzero(mask)
print('brown bbox u',xs.min(),xs.max(),'v',ys.min(),ys.max(),'n',mask.sum())
# per-column lowest brown pixel
for u in range(xs.min(),xs.max()+1,6):
    col=np.nonzero(mask[:,u])[0]
    if len(col): print(u, col.min(), col.max())
"
